description: Semiconductor dispersion / ETF-hedge failure (market-intelligence F3, FINDING 3, the clearest case). Trade #6 shorts SMH against the single-name semi longs (#1-4: NVDA/TSM/AVGO/MU); its whole risk is the SPREAD between the two, but a name-level scenario moves them in lockstep and nets the hedge to ~flat. This scenario drives the basis:SMH_SEMI factor (SMH return minus the single-name basket), so the ETF and its constituents pull apart -- the single names underperform the ETF -- and both legs of the 'hedge' lose. Pure covariance propagation; no macro/ARag services.

semis_dispersion.narrative: Semiconductor dispersion: the single-name semis (NVDA/TSM/AVGO/MU) sell off hard while the SMH ETF holds up, so the short-SMH / long-single-name relative-value trade #6 loses on both legs at once -- the classic ETF-vs-basket hedge failure a name-level covariance model nets to flat.
semis_dispersion.trigger: Single-name idiosyncratic shocks / index-vs-constituent flow divergence (not a broad tech selloff)
